paper.title: Self-entrainment of a population of coupled non-linear oscillators
paper.journal: International Symposium on Mathematical Problems in Theoretical Physics, Lecture Notes in Physics 39, Springer, pp. 420-422

headline: Kuramoto 1975 (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; synchronization onset at K=2.0 (canonical mean-field K_c~1.60); r(0.5)=0.053 -> r(3.0)=0.928

verdicts.gate: P1 incoherent at K=0.5 (r<0.3) AND synchronized at K=3.0 (r>0.6)
P2 synchronization onset in [1.0, 2.2] (first K with r>0.3; canonical K_c~1.6)
P3 order parameter r monotone non-decreasing in K

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the synchronization transition and would catch an artifact

citations: Kuramoto, Y. (1975). Self-entrainment of a population of coupled non-linear oscillators. In: International Symposium on Mathematical Problems in Theoretical Physics. Lecture Notes in Physics 39, Springer, pp. 420-422. doi:10.1007/BFb0013365.
Strogatz, S.H. (2000). From Kuramoto to Crawford: exploring the onset of synchronization in populations of coupled oscillators. Physica D 143:1-20. doi:10.1016/S0167-2789(00)00094-4.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
